title: Taraz, Zhambyl — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Taraz, Zhambyl: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Taraz is a city in Zhambyl with a population of 400,000. One of the oldest cities in Kazakhstan, a Silk Road trading post with over 2,000 years of history. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.0.
